findings.current: They didn’t even check anyone’s identity before turning around and taking off.
findings.defect: The draft adds a turn that does not occur. The ships continue onward and swiftly disappear rather than reversing direction.
findings.rationale: 휙 가 버리다 means to leave or speed away abruptly; it does not indicate turning around.
findings.replacement: They didn’t even check anyone’s identity before speeding off.
findings.source: 그런 것치고는 신분도 확인 안 하고 휙 가 버리던디.

findings.current: That was how things remained until an hour later, when an unidentified, monstrous cry rang out from somewhere.
findings.defect: The draft converts 반 시진 into an hour despite the binding glossary requiring the established term “shichen,” and it omits 고작, which emphasizes how little time passed.
findings.rationale: 반 시진 is “half a shichen,” while 고작 adds the sense of “only” or “just.”
findings.replacement: That was how things remained until, just half a shichen later, an unidentified, monstrous cry rang out from somewhere.
findings.source: 고작 반 시진 뒤, 어디선가 정체 모를 괴성이 들려오기 전까지는 그랬다.

findings.current: Damn it, that’s enough. I’m going over there, drilling a hole in their hull, and climbing aboard, so nobody try to stop me.
findings.defect: The draft changes the fisherman’s intended action by making him climb aboard the pleasure boat. In context, the dialectal 올라니까 means he will go punch a hole in the hull and come back.
findings.rationale: The fisherman is threatening a quick act of sabotage followed by his return, not boarding the other vessel.
findings.replacement: Fuck this. I’ll hurry over, punch a hole in their hull, and come right back, so nobody try to stop me.
findings.source: 시벌 안 되겄네. 내가 얼른 가서 밑창에 구멍 뚫고 올라니까, 아무도 말리지 마소.

findings.current: And everyone realized that the insane sight before them was reality.
findings.defect: The draft changes the object of realization from the bizarre noise they heard to the sight itself, losing the link between the earlier cries and the spectacle now producing them.
findings.rationale: 저 미친 소리 explicitly refers back to the strange cries, which the witnesses now connect to what they are seeing.
findings.replacement: And everyone realized that the bizarre noise they had heard was part of the reality unfolding before their eyes.
findings.source: 그리고 모두가 깨달았다. 저 미친 소리가, 자신들이 보고 있는 현실이라는 것을.

findings.current: There was an obviously foul-tempered-looking kid standing at the stern.
findings.defect: The draft sanitizes the strongly vulgar 개같이 and turns the deliberately insulting description into restrained narration.
findings.rationale: 성격 개같이 생긴 crudely describes the child as visibly having an awful personality; Taekyung’s profanity and contempt should remain strong.
findings.replacement: There was a kid standing at the stern who looked like a nasty little shit.
findings.source: 후미에 딱 봐도 성격 개같이 생긴 어린애 하나 서 있고.

findings.current: Half a shichen? I’ve almost caught up. Whew, fuck. I’ve been shitting blood.
findings.defect: The literal rendering of 피똥 쌌다 can be read as an actual medical condition in English rather than the source idiom for having endured extreme exertion.
findings.rationale: 피똥 싸다 is a vulgar hyperbolic idiom for going through severe hardship or exertion, not a statement that he literally passed blood.
findings.replacement: Half a shichen? I’ve almost caught up. Whew, fuck me. I busted my ass getting here.
findings.source: 반 시진이요? 거의 다 따라잡았네. 후우, 시벌 거. 피똥 쌌다.

findings.current: I grabbed one of them, gave it a little mental education, summoned its companions, and founded the Shark Water-Ski Team.
findings.defect: “Gave it a little mental education” is an unnatural dictionary calque that obscures the euphemistic joke about beating the shark into submission.
findings.rationale: 정신 교육하다 is used humorously here to mean disciplining or forcibly teaching it a lesson; the replacement preserves that euphemism in natural English.
findings.replacement: I grabbed one of them, taught it a lesson, called over more of its kind, and founded the Shark Water-Ski Team.
findings.source: 나는 한 놈을 붙잡아 정신 교육한 뒤 동족을 불러왔고, 상어 수상스키단을 창단했다.

summary: Two altered actions require correction, along with one glossary mismatch and several localized fidelity, register, and idiom issues.
